🔤 Chapter 1 — Simple Words

Let's learn easy words!

🌞 1. Hello & Goodbye

English 🇬🇧Tiếng Việt 🇻🇳
Hello! 👋Xin chào!
Hi! 😊Chào bạn!
Good morning! 🌅Chào buổi sáng!
Goodbye! 👋Tạm biệt!

😊 2. Feelings

English 🇬🇧Tiếng Việt 🇻🇳
Happy 😄Vui vẻ
Sad 😢Buồn
Hungry 🍔Đói bụng
Tired 😴Mệt mỏi

🔢 3. Numbers 1–10

1 one · 2 two · 3 three · 4 four · 5 five

6 six · 7 seven · 8 eight · 9 nine · 10 ten

1 một · 2 hai · 3 ba · 4 bốn · 5 năm · 6 sáu · 7 bảy · 8 tám · 9 chín · 10 mười

🎮 Try it! Cover the English side. Look at the Tiếng Việt words and say the English word out loud before you check!
  • ⭐ I can say hello and goodbye
  • ⭐ I can say how I feel
  • ⭐ I can count to 10 in English

👋 Chapter 2 — Let's Talk!

Easy things to say!

😊 1. What's Your Name?

English: What's your name?

Bạn tên gì?

English: My name is _______.

Tên tôi là _______.

❤️ 2. I Like…

English: I like apples. 🍎

Tôi thích táo.

English: I love ice cream! 🍦

Tôi yêu kem!

👦👧 3. How Old Are You?

English: How old are you?

Bạn bao nhiêu tuổi?

English: I am _______ years old.

Tôi _______ tuổi.

🎮 Try it! Practice with a friend or parent: ask each other's name, age, and one thing you like!
  • ⭐ I can say my name
  • ⭐ I can say what I like
  • ⭐ I can say how old I am
